# onepassword_router (Resource)

Manage 1Password router items.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Item title.
- `vault` (String) 1Password vault title.

### Optional

- `airport_id` (String) Airport ID.
- `attached_storage_password` (Block, Optional) Attached storage password recipe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--attached_storage_password))
- `base_station` (Block, Optional) Base station credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--base_station))
- `network_name` (String) Network name.
- `note` (String) Item note.
- `notes` (String) Item notes (deprecated in favor of note).
- `sections` (Attributes) Item sections map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections))
- `server_ip` (String) Router server IP.
- `tags` (List of String) Item tags.
- `version` (Number) Version trigger to refresh ephemeral values.
- `wireless` (Block, Optional) Wireless settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--wireless))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Item ID.
